name: Quattro Bajeena
source:
From: Mobile Suit Z Gundam
The MS team commander of the Argama, an A.E.U.G. cruiser. His rank is lieutenant, but he did more than simply pilot a Rick Dias and Hyaku Shiki in combat. He was also a key member of the A.E.U.G. that hadsignificant say in strategic decisions.
